description: de-duplicated (58-twin) re-run of exp21b-lite with sentence-level permutation null and pooled across-split test

split.rationale: exp21b proportions 0.60/0.20/0.20 of 60 give 34.8/11.6/11.6 on 58; val and test are held at 12 couples so every test statistic keeps the exact shape it had in exp21b and the AUCs stay comparable; the 2 removed couples come out of train.

protocol.model_selection: max val margin, checked every 200 iters (exp21b rule)

dedup.rule: couple signature = (svo text, vso text); keep first occurrence

permutation_scheme.null: uniform bijection pi over the 12 test twin couples reassigns which VSO sentence-state is the twin of each SVO sentence-state; the 24 sentence states and the negative pair set are held fixed; AUC recomputed per draw
permutation_scheme.why_valid: randomisation acts on the twin assignment, not on the fidelity values, so the dependence induced by each sentence appearing in ~5 within-order (B) pairs is carried identically into every replicate; B is ancillary (untouched by pi) for the primary endpoint
permutation_scheme.old_scheme_defect: exp21b permuted the A/B label over the pooled 72 fidelities, which requires those 72 dependent values to be exchangeable; they are not, so the null was too tight and p too small
permutation_scheme.derangement_variant: pi restricted to have no fixed points; removes the conservatism of retaining ~1 true twin per draw, so a non-significant result cannot be dismissed as low power
permutation_scheme.a_vs_c_caveat: for A_vs_C the negatives are themselves cross-order pairs, so a permuted A-pair can coincide with a C-pair; this makes A_vs_C mildly conservative

C1_bow.note: twins are identical vectors: order-blind by construction on matched pairs

one_sample_t_vs_0.5.caveat: the 5 splits re-sample the SAME 58 couples / 116 sentences, so they are not independent replicates; this t-test treats them as independent and its p is therefore optimistic (an upper bound on the evidence for transfer)

fisher_combination_of_sentence_level_p.caveat: same non-independence caveat as the t-test

rule.robust_transfer: pooled one-sided p < 0.05 AND >=3/5 seeds significant at Bonferroni alpha = 0.05/5 = 0.01
rule.c2_dominates: mean C2 test AUC - mean POST quantum test AUC > 0.15 AND mean C2 test AUC >= 0.90
rule.pooled_p_definition: one-sided (greater) one-sample t of the 5 POST test A_vs_B AUCs against 0.5, df=4
